content: The AHA 2011 schedule outlines the coordination of TV events during the conference. Filming will take place at the Peabody Hotel, with the exact location to be determined. Open time slots are highlighted in red. Below is the detailed schedule for each day: Sunday, November 13, 2011 11:00 AM 11:30 AM Interviewee: Dr. Holger Thiele Topic: AIDA STEMI trial: A comparison of intracoronary versus intravenous bolus abciximab application during primary percutaneous coronary intervention. Embargo Lift: 3:45 PM on Sunday, November 13, 2011 11:30 AM 12:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Gregg Stone Topic: ADAPT-DES: A large-scale, prospective, multicenter registry examining the relationship between platelet responsiveness and stent thrombosis after drug-eluting stent implantation. 1:00 PM Open Time Slot 1:30 PM Open Time Slot 2:00 PM 2:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Thomas Aversano Topic: Outcomes of non-primary PCI at hospitals with and without on-site cardiac surgery: A randomized study (CPORT-E). Embargo Lift: 11:51 AM on Monday, November 14, 2011 2:30 PM Open Time Slot 3:00 PM 3:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Jens Cosedis Nielsen Topic: MANTRA-PAF trial: A randomized multicenter comparison of radiofrequency ablation and antiarrhythmic drug therapy as first-line treatment in patients with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Embargo Lift: 4:29 PM on Monday, November 14, 2011 3:30 PM 4:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Kenneth Mahaffey Topic: TRA-CER trial: The thrombin receptor antagonist for clinical event reduction in acute coronary syndrome. Embargo Lift: 4:51 PM on Sunday, November 13, 2011 4:00 PM 4:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Samuel Goldhaber Topic: ADOPT trial: Extended anticoagulant prophylaxis in initially hospitalized medically ill patients. Embargo Lift: 4:29 PM on Sunday, November 13, 2011 4:30 PM 5:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Renato Lopes Topic: AHA wrap-up in Portuguese. 5:00 PM 5:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Niteesh Choudhry Topic: Post-MI FREEE trial: The impact of full coverage for preventive medications after myocardial infarction on recurrent vascular events. Embargo Lift: 10:45 AM on Monday, November 14, 2011 5:30 PM 6:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Gilles Montalescot Topic: AHA wrap-up in French. Monday, November 14, 2011 8:00 AM Open Time Slot 8:30 AM 9:00 AM Interviewees: Dr. A. Verheugt, Dr. Jan Hein Cornel, and Dr. Ton Oude Ophuis Topic: AHA wrap-up from a Dutch perspective. 9:00 AM 9:30 AM Interviewee: Dr. Peter Kowey Topic: ALPHEE trial: A double-blind, placebo-controlled dose-ranging study of celivarone for the prevention of ICD interventions or death, with amiodarone as a calibrator. Embargo Lift: 3:45 PM on Monday, November 14, 2011 9:30 AM 10:00 AM Interviewee: Dr. Lucas Boersma Topic: Atrial fibrillation catheter ablation versus surgical ablation treatment: A multicenter randomized clinical trial. Embargo Lift: 4:07 PM on Monday, November 14, 2011 11:00 AM 11:30 AM Interviewee: Dr. Jay H. Traverse Topic: Late-TIME trial: Evaluating the safety and effect of administering bone marrow mononuclear cells 2 to 3 weeks after acute myocardial infarction. 2:30 PM 3:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. John Spertus Topic: Testing an evidence-based, individualized informed consent form to improve patients' experiences with PCI. Embargo Lift: 11:29 AM on Monday, November 14, 2011 3:00 PM 3:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Basil Lewis Topic: AHA wrap-up in Hebrew. 3:30 PM 4:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Kenneth Mahaffey Topic: TRA-CER trial: The thrombin receptor antagonist for clinical event reduction in acute coronary syndrome. Tuesday, November 15, 2011 8:00 AM 8:30 AM Interviewee: Dr. Paul Armstrong Topic: AHA wrap-up from a Canadian perspective. 8:30 AM 9:00 AM Interviewee: Dr. Harvey White Topic: AHA wrap-up from a Pacific Rim perspective. 10:30 AM 11:00 AM Interviewee: Dr. Adnan Kastrati Topic: ISAR-REACT 4 trial: Abciximab plus unfractionated heparin versus bivalirudin in patients with non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction undergoing PCI. Embargo Lift: 4:07 PM on Sunday, November 13, 2011 1:30 PM 2:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Jessica Mega Topic: ELEVATE-TIMI 56 trial: Escalating clopidogrel using a genetic strategy. Embargo Lift: 11:51 AM on Wednesday, November 16, 2011 2:00 PM 2:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Emile Mohler Topic: CLEVER study: Six-month outcomes of claudication treatment comparative effectiveness. Embargo Lift: 11:07 AM on Wednesday, November 16, 2011 2:30 PM 3:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. William Boden Topic: AIM-HIGH trial: Extended-release niacin does not reduce clinical events in patients with established cardiovascular disease optimally controlled with statin therapy. Embargo Lift: 11:51 AM on Tuesday, November 15, 2011 3:00 PM 3:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Sergio Leonardi Topic: AHA wrap-up in Italian. 3:30 PM 4:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Hisao Ogawa Topic: AHA wrap-up in Japanese. 4:30 PM 5:00 PM Interviewees: Dr. Lars Wallentin and Dr. Stefan James Topic: AHA wrap-up from a Scandinavian perspective. This schedule provides a comprehensive overview of the interviews and topics covered during the AHA 2011 conference.
